title: Indexed filtered bare aggregate optimization
scope: database core filtered aggregate execution for production benchmark stability
constraints: Do not modify benchmark thresholds or gate profiles as an optimization lever
Verify targeted tpcc/tsbs repeat before production medium repeat
Use production medium gate as authoritative verifier

database_changes: stream bare aggregate column scans through scan_prefix_for_each instead of materializing all key-value pairs
use primary-key or single-column BTree equality predicates as candidate sources for filtered bare aggregate scans
preserve predicate/aggregate partial column decoding so unrelated columns are not decoded
